corpus.coverage: Prose on pages 10–396. Cover, contents, calendar/contact tables, small-print footnotes, course-list rows, and fragments under 20 words are excluded. Exact duplicate text is retained only once; chapter, section, subsection, and start/end pages come from PDF bookmarks and text positions.

model.name: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
model.aggregation: Token-count-weighted mean of normalized window vectors, then L2 normalization; no passage tail is truncated.
